Method of Attack: Improper access to freed memory allowing compromising or manipulating sensitive data
Exploitation of a race condition to perform improper GPU operations to access already freed memory
Impacted Systems: Midgard GPU kernel driver versions r12p0 to r32p0
Bifrost GPU kernel driver versions r0p0 to r42p0
Valhall GPU kernel driver versions r19p0 to r42p0
Arm 5th Gen GPU architecture kernel driver versions r41p0 to r42p0
Devices using Valhall architecture (Mali-G77) including Samsung Galaxy S20/S20 FE, Xiaomi Redmi K30/K40, Motorola Edge 40, OnePlus Nord 2
Devices using Arm 5th Gen GPU architecture (Mali-G720, Mali-G620)
Attack Vector: Local access on the device, typically via tricking users to download applications from unofficial repositories
